effects.text: Builds and keeps muscle mass, size and strength

quotes: Androgen deficiency accounted for decreases in lean mass, muscle size, and strength
aromatization was important in mediating testosterone effects in reducing fat mass and sexual function but not on muscle mass or strength

effects.text: Drives red blood cell production, so hemoglobin rises on testosterone

quotes: In androgen deficient men, hemoglobin typically increases by ~10% (or up to 20 g/L) with standard testosterone doses

effects.text: Grows body and facial hair and stimulates sebum (oily skin, acne at high levels)

quotes: increased truncal and facial hair growth
Seborrhea and acne are commonly associated with high androgen levels

effects.text: Grows the prostate, mainly through DHT made inside it

quotes: over 95% of testosterone entering the prostate being converted to the more potent androgen DHT
[In congenital 5α-reductase deficiency] Prostate development remains rudimentary

effects.text: Sustains sperm production, which needs testosterone far above blood levels inside the testis

quotes: Testosterone is essential for maintaining spermatogenesis and male fertility.
high local concentrations (up to 1 μg/g tissue, ~100 times higher than blood concentrations) … of intratesticular testosterone

effects.text: Male-pattern scalp hair loss in susceptible men, which depends on DHT

quotes: temporal hair loss or balding may also be seen even with physiologic testosterone replacement in susceptible men
[In congenital 5α-reductase deficiency] sparse body hair without balding is characteristic

effects.text: Matures bone, keeps bone density, and closes the growth plates (epiphyses)

quotes: all men with aromatase deficiency have tall stature, delayed bone maturation, osteopenia or osteoporosis and eunuchoid skeletal proportions
the presence of unfused epiphyses and undetectable serum estradiol levels
estrogen deficiency primarily accounted for increases in body fat

effects.text: Supports sexual desire and function, together with testosterone

quotes: both contributed to the decline in sexual function

effects.text: Negative feedback that lowers LH secretion, at both the hypothalamus and the pituitary

quotes: estrogen has dual sites of negative feedback, acting at the hypothalamus to decrease GnRH pulse frequency and at the pituitary

effects.text: Grows breast tissue (gynecomastia) when estrogen outweighs androgen

quotes: Estrogen, acting through its estrogen receptor (ER), promotes ductal growth
causing an elevation in the estrogen to androgen ratio, can induce gynecomastia
